title: Tripartite Standards for Employment of Term Contract Employees
what_it_is: Tripartite Standards for Employment of Term Contract Employees

sections.label: Tripartite Standard employer adoption
sections.summary: Over 400 employers adopted the Standard covering more than 28,000 resident term contract employees, with TAFEP handling non-compliance reports and a planned review.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Since then, well over 400 employers have adopted the Standard, accounting for more than 28,000 or 17% of all resident term contract employees.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Instead of relying on audits, the Standard spells out clearly verifiable actions that employers commit to undertake and relies on employers' self-assessments of their ability to comply.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: If their employees experience any difficulty arising from non-compliance with the Standard, they can report to The Tripartite Alliance for Fair and Progressive Employment Practices (TAFEP), which will contact the employer to clarify their practices or to change them, so as to meet the Standard.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Our current focus is to increase the number of employers adopting this Standard.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We will also consult with our tripartite partners at an appropriate time to review the Standard so as to ensure it remains relevant.

sections.label: Tripartite Standard Framework launch
sections.summary: The Tripartite Standard Framework and the Standard for Term Contract Employees were launched two months ago, with over 400 companies adopting.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The Tripartite Standard Framework has just been launched, in fact, two months ago, at the same time that we launched the Standard for Term Contract Employees.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: In just two months, more than 400 companies with about 17% of the resident Term Contract Employees base is not bad.

sections.label: Self-assessment and employee reporting
sections.summary: Self-assessment eases companies, and employees who find declared practices differ are encouraged to inform TAFEP.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The intent of self-assessment is to make it easier for the companies.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: If, however, they have employees who look at what the company has declared and say that, "This is quite different from what they actually practise", then, what we do is to encourage the employees to let TAFEP know.
